archetype_name: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Utilitarian Public Health)

buttons.primary: bg-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-900 text-white font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.fab: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14 bg-blue-800 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-900 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(30,64,175,0.3)] transition-transform hover:scale-105 z-50

inputs.text: w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-3 text-base text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 bg-white placeholder-slate-400 transition-shadow
inputs.label: block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
cards.visit_empty: bg-white border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
cards.visit_completed: bg-white border border-slate-200 border-l-4 border-l-green-600 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md transition-all

icons.usage: Use icons for navigation, visit status (check-circle for completed, circle for empty), and actions (export, edit, trash).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) and increase shadow on hover. On mobile, provide immediate visual feedback on tap (active:bg-slate-100).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out' globally for color and shadow changes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Primary buttons must have white text against dark blue.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44px. Inputs should have ample padding (py-3).

views.name: Dashboard / Form List
views.description: Main screen listing previously saved D1 forms.
views.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card displays Data, Localidade, Atividade, and a progress summary (e.g., '20/20 Visitas').
views.actions: FAB to create new form. Swipe or dropdown on cards to Edit, Export, or Delete.

views.name: Form Entry - Header & Settings
views.description: General data for the daily service summary.
views.layout: Standard mobile form layout (single column). Fields: Município, Localidade, Categoria, Zona, Folha, Data, Atividade.

views.name: Form Entry - Visits List (20 fixed rows)
views.description: The main data entry area for the 20 property visits.
views.layout: Scrollable vertical list of 20 cards representing rows. Empty cards show 'Visita #'. Tapping a card opens a full-screen drawer/modal for that specific row.

row_entry_modal.description: Drawer or modal that contains the complex fields for a single visit.
fields: Tipo do Imóvel (Residência, Comércio, Terreno Baldio, P.E, Outros)

views.name: Form Entry - Summary & Deposits
views.description: Bottom section of the form with totals and deposit classifications.
views.layout: Read-only summary cards aggregating data from the 20 visits. Form sections for A1, A2, B, C, D1, D2, E deposit counts. Signature text fields at the very bottom.

implementation_notes.state_management: Use a robust form state or local context to hold the 20 rows of data. Auto-save to localStorage/IndexedDB frequently to prevent data loss in the field.
implementation_notes.export_functionality: For CSV, generate a standard comma-separated string. For PDF, use a library like jspdf and jspdf-autotable to mimic the official D1 tabular layout.
implementation_notes.mobile_optimizations: Use type='number' for numeric fields to trigger the numpad on mobile. Use Shadcn's Select or native <select> styled cleanly for dropdowns (Tipo do Imóvel, Pendência).
